[LNAM.2.4.1] The compiler must normalize every identifier to **NFC** (UAX #15) at
lex time, before interning, comparison, and emission. Source text may arrive in any
normalization form. *(NFC, not NFKC. NFC answers "same name" for encoding
differences; it does not fold compatibility variants — `²`→`2`, `ﬁ`→`fi`, full-width
→ half-width — which NFKC would, silently merging visually-distinct names. The
dangerous cross-script look-alikes NFKC cannot fold anyway are handled by the
mixed-script reject [LNAM.2.5.1].)*
